name: Rakuka Rizo

appearance.build: Athletic, built for quick bursts rather than sustained effort.
appearance.other: Wears a dangling earring with sentimental value on his right ear. Everything he does in front of an audience — even an audience of one — gets a little bit of a flourish.

personality.summary: Dramatic and enthusiastic in everything he does. Makes any boring situation fun by cheering everyone up, whether they asked for it or not.
personality.in_class: Takes notes. His face shows exactly what he thinks of every lesson in real time. Teachers have mixed feelings about this.
personality.in_combat: Announces his moves before he makes them. Has been told to stop announcing his moves. Cannot stop announcing his moves — it's half the reason the class always knows when he's about to pull someone out of danger.
personality.quirk_of_character: Treats every rescue like the crowd's watching, whether or not it actually is. Somewhere in that theatrical streak is a genuine, uncomplicated need to be the reason someone's okay.

ability_scores.note: CHA primary — Dying Flight is a performance as much as a maneuver, and force of personality shapes how far he can push it. TECH secondary for the split-second timing a hit-and-run flight requires.

class_note: Dying Flight is a rescue-oriented, in-and-out combat tool — Field Physician's support-under-fire features suit getting allies out of danger fast, then getting out himself.

quirk_mechanics.weakness: The flight window is short and burns fast — pushing past its safe duration risks a hard, uncontrolled landing. Every use is visible to everyone, including allies; he can't fly in or out subtly.

dm_notes.combat_role: Flies in, flies out, hit and run. His real value is getting allies out of danger — swooping in to lift someone clear before the situation gets worse.
dm_notes.social_role: Class morale engine. When things go badly, his face is readable and his response to bad news is usually — somehow — funny. He doesn't mean to be. He just can't hide how he's processing things.
dm_notes.growth_arc: Learning discretion. The theatrical instinct is a liability in covert missions and emotional conversations with real stakes. Finding out that sometimes the most powerful thing is silence — and sitting with that knowledge.
dm_notes.weakness_to_exploit: Every flight telegraphs — enemies always know where he's going and when. Low WIS means he doesn't always read a situation correctly before committing to it.
